log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Mirror match is decided by Primarina walling Garchomp, Incineroar and Dragonite, but it has a bad matchup into Gholdengo. Incineroar lead avoids that bad matchup with Intimidate pivot, and fast Garchomp gives a likely knockout on Gholdengo.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Following Pokémon battle rules to select a single legal action based on speed, knockout, or matchup.Selecting three Pokémon and ordering them for the team preview under the battle constraints.Evaluating the mirror matchup to pick a lead and two teammates that cover each other's weaknesses.Selecting Incineroar as lead with Primarina and Garchomp as back to cover the mirror threats.

decisions.thought: Opposing Garchomp is faster and threatens super-effective Earthquake, so priority is deciding. Fake Out flinches it before it moves for free chip and scouting.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating the optimal first turn move for Incineroar against an Attack-lowered Garchomp with hidden opponent team members.Checking Fake Out mechanics against a possible switch and flinch interaction.

decisions.thought: Incineroar is slower and 2x weak to Ground, so Earthquake likely knocks it out even at -1. Staying for Parting Shot risks dying first. Our Garchomp outspeeds and survives to threaten back.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating turn 2 options for Incineroar versus Mega Garchomp while accounting for hidden opponent team members and attack stat penalty.Assessing Parting Shot to lower attack and pivot out against the faster Mega Garchomp.Evaluating Parting Shot's pivot mechanics and damage against Mega Garchomp's Earthquake.Comparing Earthquake damage ranges for Incineroar, Primarina, and Garchomp to assess OHKO risk and switch options.

decisions.thought: We outspeed opposing Mega Garchomp, so our STAB super-effective Dragon Claw moves first. Mega Evolving boosts Attack to secure the likely knockout before a second Earthquake.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating speed tiers and Mega Evolution timing to determine the optimal move against the opposing Mega Garchomp.Comparing damage ranges of Dragon Claw versus Earthquake against the opposing Mega Garchomp.

decisions.thought: Opponent Mega Garchomp is at 6% and weakened by Intimidate. Incineroar's Fake Out has priority to guarantee the knockout before it moves. Primarina would have to take a hit due to slower speed.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Incineroar versus Primarina to safely finish a low-HP Mega Garchomp while accounting for remaining unknown opponent Pokémon.Comparing Incineroar's priority Fake Out KO and Intimidate survivability against Primarina's slower non-priority KO risk.

decisions.thought: Opponent Garchomp is faster and at 6% HP, so speed is the deciding factor. Fake Out has +3 priority and should secure the knockout while preventing any incoming damage.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon battle rules and LEGAL ACTIONS format to select a single best turn action under level 50 constraints.Evaluating remaining opponent options and move matchups to choose the optimal single action.Selecting priority Fake Out to secure the knockout before the faster opponent acts.

decisions.thought: Incineroar is in a bad matchup into Primarina and risks a knockout from super-effective Water. Pivoting out is required. Parting Shot weakens it before bringing our own Primarina in safely.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Reviewing Pokémon battle rules and response format constraints for a single turn action.Evaluating type matchups and move legality to choose a single valid action.Balancing speed uncertainty and damage risk to prefer a pivot move over a direct switch.

decisions.thought: Parting Shot forces Incineroar to switch out, leaving Primarina as the only legal option. Incineroar is also in a bad matchup versus Water-type Primarina.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating speed, knockout potential, and matchup to select one legal action within format constraints.Assessing type advantage and stat changes to pick a legal move within format limits.

decisions.thought: Switching to Incineroar is a bad matchup into Water/Fairy STAB. Opponent is at -1 SpA and did ~15% with Sparkling Aria, so we can set up. Calm Mind wins the mirror.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Primarina type matchups and stat debuffs to select the optimal move.Assessing damage tradeoffs and speed uncertainty to choose between attacking, boosting, or switching.Evaluating Calm Mind versus Moonblast given the opponent's -1 SpA debuff and mirror matchup risk.Assessing Calm Mind against Moonblast for the mirror matchup with a -1 SpA advantage and switch risk.

decisions.thought: Opponent Primarina proved faster last turn, but it is at -1 SpA versus our +1 SpD so we survive its Moonblast twice. Our +1 Moonblast should 2HKO it first for the knockout.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Primarina's optimal move against the opponent's low-HP Garchomp and potential switch-ins.Assessing type matchups and stat boosts to choose between Moonblast and Sparkling Aria.Evaluating damage ranges and speed order to compare Calm Mind versus attacking or pivoting with Flip Turn.Comparing Calm Mind versus Moonblast given damage, speed, and boost tradeoffs.Evaluating Calm Mind versus Moonblast against a faster opponent with a speed and boost disadvantage.

decisions.thought: Opponent Primarina is at 16% after taking our +1 Moonblast, so another Moonblast is a likely knockout. We survive their -1 Moonblast even if they move first.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Following the Pokémon battle rules to select a single legal action based on speed, knockout potential, or matchup.Evaluating speed uncertainty and legal move constraints before choosing the turn action.Calculating damage and speed to confirm a guaranteed KO with the selected move.

decisions.thought: Mega Garchomp is faster and Earthquake will knock out Primarina before it moves. Preserving the +1 boosts is key, so switch out of this bad matchup.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing turn options using speed, knockout potential, and matchup to select one legal action.Evaluating a switch to Incineroar against a low-HP faster opponent to avoid a likely KO.Assessing damage calculations and speed to justify switching to Incineroar and preserving Primarina's boosts.

decisions.thought: Garchomp-Mega is faster and Earthquake would knock out Incineroar. Fake Out has +3 priority to flinch it first and should finish its 6% HP.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating turn action for Pokémon Champions singles by applying speed, knockout, and matchup rules to select one legal move or switch.Applying speed and priority rules to rule out non-priority moves against a faster opponent.Selecting priority Fake Out to KO the low-HP opponent before it can act.

decisions.thought: Incineroar is slower than Dragonite and Flare Blitz is resisted, so staying in is a bad matchup. Parting Shot weakens Dragonite and pivots to Primarina which threatens it with Moonblast.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Incineroar's legal moves against Dragonite and low-HP Garchomp while weighing switching to Primarina.Assessing Multiscale versus Inner Focus based on Fake Out damage and flinch outcome.Evaluating Parting Shot for a safe pivot versus a direct switch given the HP and type matchup.

decisions.thought: Incineroar fainted so I must send in the last Pokemon. Primarina is the only legal switch.
Dragonite is faster so it moves first and likely knocks out our low-HP Primarina. With no healthy bench to switch to, our only chance is maximum super-effective damage.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon battle state to select one legal move or switch under format constraints.Evaluating damage and speed against a faster Mega Dragonite to pick a single legal move.Calculating damage ranges for Moonblast versus Earthquake to confirm the KO and survival odds.
